name: Low-Impact Dance

instructions.description: Choose a simple repeating step pattern.
Move to the rhythm using comfortable side and forward steps.
Add gentle arm movements if balance permits.
Reduce complexity before fatigue affects coordination.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

commentsNotes: Use simple patterns and avoid abrupt direction changes if unsteady.

variations.variationDescription: Low-Impact Dance — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.
